issues.description: Visibility mismatch for Farm.singFarmSongVerse(Animal): The UML in the problem statement and the template declare singFarmSongVerse as a private method (UML shows '-' and the template has a private method signature with the Animal parameter commented out), but the solution implements this helper as protected. This difference in visibility is a structural inconsistency that could confuse students about the intended visibility (private vs. protected) and about whether the method is part of the class' external contract or purely an internal helper. While it does not block implementing the core behavior, it is an unintended structural mismatch between the artifacts.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the visibility consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution's singFarmSongVerse to private to match the UML and template, or update the UML/template to indicate protected visibility (and adjust the template method signature accordingly). Prefer making the solution private if the method is an internal helper, or explicitly document why it should be protected if subclass access is required.
